info.title: AutoPay Guard API
info.description: Privacy-first API for identity, households, manual recurring commitments, deterministic occurrence projections and a fictional .example merchant catalog. This API never accepts payment credentials or initiates payments.

get.summary: Get the current user's global notification preferences
get.description: A missing record is represented as disabled synthetic version 0.

put.description: The first explicit opt-in or saved opt-out uses If-Match "0". Later writes use the latest returned ETag.

detail.example: One or more request fields are invalid.

ApiProblem.description: RFC 9457-style problem details returned as application/problem+json.

ageConfirmed.description: The current user confirms they are at least 18.

privacyNoticeAccepted.description: The current user accepts the named privacy notice.

privacyNoticeVersion.description: Must exactly match the privacy notice version supported by the API.

CreateHouseholdRequest.description: Onboarding and household creation are committed atomically. All fields are required.

CreateCommitmentRequest.description: Manual recurring commitment input. Ownership, provenance, confidence and visibility are derived by the server.

verificationDueReached.description: Server-derived due-date boundary in the attempt household timezone. Idempotent mutation replays preserve the original response snapshot; refetch the attempt to refresh this projection.

UpdateCommitmentRequest.description: Full editable commitment representation. If-Match protects against lost updates.

ProjectionPeriod.description: Exact scheduled occurrences inside an inclusive local-calendar window. No foreign exchange, fractional proration or rounding is performed.
